invariants: GET / returns HTTP 200 and the reviewed visit-counter sentence through the gateway.
The visit counter strictly increases across gateway probes (shared Redis).
After a web replica restart, the service becomes healthy again on loopback.
limits: The repository Compose file and Dockerfile are not executed.
The load generator and the service share one host; absolute numbers are lab-only.
Only the reviewed adapter workload path is exercised.

unsupported: Repository compose.yml, web/Dockerfile and nginx/ are not executed.
The repository publishes Redis on a host port; DARWIN keeps Redis internal.
No Express cluster mode is invented: this application is single-process.
No framework conversion, cache TTL invention, or database addition.
